title: GOLD_ML_V1 research continues on the assistant side
message: Do not run Batch024, Batch025 or Batch026 locally. Batch024 produced zero survivors. Candidate-specific composite loss filters in Batch025 produced five 2023-internal candidates but zero 2024 survivors. Shared directional loss trees in Batch026 produced zero candidates passing the 2023 gate. Local implementation remains disabled until at least one new candidate passes the frozen research, validation and final-test gates. The assistant is now researching new base event families rather than rescuing the failed Batch024 lineage.
